summary: This informational document defines the xml2rfc version 3 vocabulary, an XML-based language for writing RFCs and Internet-Drafts. It is heavily derived from the version 2 vocabulary and obsoletes the v2 grammar described in RFC 7749.

eli5.summary: Authors write RFCs with special tags, like instructions for a typesetter. This is the second edition of the tag list, with a few improvements.

questions: how to write rfcs in xml
